overview: Evolve the RSS viewer into a Feedly-style experience with a multi-feed library, categories, unread tracking, saved items, search, and OPML import/export, all without accounts.
goals: Multi-feed library with categories and counts
Unread tracking with per-feed and per-category totals
successMetrics: User can manage a library of feeds and categories locally
Unread counts update accurately as items are marked read
Search returns results across loaded items in under 200ms for typical libraries
openQuestions: Should unread state persist across sessions? (default: yes, localStorage)
How many items per feed should be cached? (default: 50)

routes.name: Reader
routes.purpose: Feed sidebar + item list + article view

uiNotes: Three-pane layout: sidebar (feeds/categories), list (items), detail (article preview)
Search bar in the list pane
Mobile: sidebar collapses; item list and detail stack
rules: Persist library, items, read/saved states in localStorage
Unread counts exclude items marked read
OPML export reflects current library structure
Keep per-feed item cache capped at 50 items

stories.title: Library persistence and data model
stories.description: As a user, I want my feed library and categories to persist locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a localStorage-backed library model for feeds and categories
Existing OPML import writes into the library model
Library loads on startup and populates the sidebar

stories.title: Item caching and unread tracking
stories.description: As a reader, I want unread counts that update as I read items.
acceptanceCriteria: Cache up to 50 items per feed in localStorage
Unread counts roll up to feed and category levels

stories.title: Saved/Read Later view
stories.description: As a user, I want to save items and view them later.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a save toggle on item cards
Create a Saved view that lists saved items

stories.title: Search across cached items
stories.description: As a user, I want to search items across my library.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a search input that filters cached items by title/summary
Search results render in the list pane
Clearing search restores the current feed list

stories.title: OPML export
stories.description: As a user, I want to export my library as OPML.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate an OPML file from the current library
